name: domain-e2e-second-driven-by-preserved
body: `testutil::valid_model` carries a second `driven-by` from the Service to `requirements.requirement.refund`, so dropping the Service's `place-order` `driven-by` leaves it still driven and the domain/solution/all stderr carries only the requirement-coverage message, not the Domain-local `Service … driven-by no Requirement` one. The test's `contains` assertions hold either way; upgrade by dropping both `driven-by` edges if an exclusive-error assertion is ever wanted.
